title: Marge mistakes Johnny Hodges for Zutty at the Ritz Hotel
summary: In a Chicago hotel with the Ellington band, a tipsy Marge went to the wrong floor and pulled the sheet off Johnny Hodges, accusing his wife Cue of being with Zutty; they have called her wife-in-law since.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: You were talking about when you were in Chicago in a hotel?
Yes, and we were living at the Ritz Hotel. That's at Oakland Boulevard and South

Parkway. So the Ellington band happened to be in town so Marge came in some kind of way there and she got the floors mixed up. Looked like we were on the third floor and Johnny and (Cue) were on the fourth floor see.
Johnny Hodges and his wife?

Yes, Johnny Hodges. So Marge came on upstairs you know and got off at the wrong floor but the same room you know. Boy she looked in there and Johnny had his head covered up you know. She couldn't see who he was there. And she give Johnny hell. (LAUGHTER).

She said, oh yes, that's why you wanted to leave. Looked like I had to leave her in someone's room to come upstairs see. And so she said, oh yes, that's why you wanted to leave me and come upstairs, see. And come to find out it was Johnny Hodges, covered up in the bed. And (Cue) was scared to death you know. (LAUGHTER). And it was really something. Because Marge can.....
The time you surprised Johnny Hodges in Chicago.
Oh yes. Well we had been downstairs all of us in Otto and Sonny's room having a ball. Drinking. Having a good time Zutty

and I and oh some of the other musicians. Because Sonny Greer and Otto, as soon as they would come in an hotel, they'd put red lights in their room. And the socket on the floor and fix it, oh they'd fix it up. And that was the room to ball in. And we had been up there drinking and having a ball.

So Zutty said, I think I'll, oh I'm going Marge, said you can stay up here if you want to. Well as I tell you, he accused me of every man in the world because he was so jealous. I couldn't understand what he was going to do. Letting me stay up there with all those guys and all and he's going to go downstairs and go to bed.

So I said, well I believe I'll go down, I stayed. And old Sonny and them said, yes stay Marge. And they were playing records and all. And so I said, I believe I'll go down. And I went down and I was half drunk too. And put the key in the door, and couldn't get the door opened. But I knocked on the door and came to the door.
And Johnny Hodges had pulled the sheet up over his head. He was in the bed. And I walked right over to the bed and I said, that's why you left me up
there, I can see it now.
Oh, she tells it better than you.
(LAUGHTER).

Yes. I said, now I can see why you let me upstairs. Yes, and Oh I started to calling Cue names before I'd even seen Johnny Hodges. Oh, you've been with Zutt y and she was standing there shivering you know. And I jerked the sheet down and it was Johnny Hodges. (LAUGHTER). Well I said, I'm so sorry.
I never did forget that thing.
I said, and now they call me wife-in-law. (LAUGHTER). That's what Johnny and Cue call me, say, hello wife in-law. (LAUGHTER). Oh yes they still laugh.
When I saw (Que?) at Charlie Shavers, she Procope started to telling (Poke?) and them, Poke wife you know. Say, this Marge is something else. (LAUGHTER).
That's how easy you get yourself into a situation and get yourself shot. (LAUGHTER).
Yes.
Sure.
